第一步：把牙科保险与一般医保分开: Step 1: separate dental benefits from medical insurance
有医疗保险不代表所有牙科项目都被支付。Medicare 官方说明，大多数常规洗牙: Medical insurance does not mean every dental service is covered. Medicare says Original Medicare generally does not pay for routine cleanings, fillings, extractions, dentures or implants; exceptions may apply to dental services directly linked to certain covered medical treatments. Ask your dental or Medicare Advantage plan about the particular procedure rather than only whether the clinic accepts insurance.
请保险计划和诊所分别确认：牙医是否属于你的具体网络，现在是否接收新病人。: Confirm with both the plan and clinic whether the dentist is in your exact network and accepting new patients.
问清检查、X 光及后续治疗的保障、自付额、共同支付、年度上限、等待期和事先批准要: Ask about exam, X-ray and treatment coverage, deductibles, copayments, annual limits, waiting periods and prior authorization. Leave unconfirmed amounts open.
预约时说明需要普通话、粤语或口译，确认当天能够安排的语言与费用；网站有中文不代表: Specify Mandarin, Cantonese or an interpreter and confirm availability and any charge for that visit. A Chinese website does not mean every dentist speaks Chinese.

If you cannot find a dentist accepting new patients, call the official dental service center at 1-800-322-6384. Do not assume your medical network is also your dental network.

第三步：费用吃紧时，询问有明确规则的低费路径: Step 3: ask about lower-cost routes with clear rules
NEMS（东北医疗中心）提供成人与儿童牙科，可从牙科服务页联系，并向会员服务询问: NEMS provides dental services for adults and children. Contact it through the dental page and ask Member Services about insurance and sliding-fee assistance. NEMS states that it is not a free clinic: discounts require review of household size, income and documentation, with annual re-enrollment. Uncovered or ineligible services can be charged at full cost. Confirm whether the dental procedure qualifies before submitting the requested documents.
